summary: Today's focus is on stabilizing the falling humidity trend and ensuring consistent moisture, while maintaining overall well-being.

tasks.action: Lightly mist all foliage with demineralized water for 30 seconds to gently raise ambient humidity around the leaves.
Gently insert a finger 2cm into the soil to assess moisture levels. If the top 2cm feels dry, prepare to water in the afternoon.
Observe overall leaf color and turgidity for any signs of stress or new growth emerging.
Check the current room humidity. If still below 55% RH, mist foliage again for 20 seconds to provide further relief.
If soil was dry from the morning check, provide 200ml of filtered water directly to the soil base, ensuring even distribution.
Carefully rotate the pot 45 degrees clockwise to ensure all sides receive balanced light exposure.
Ensure no water droplets remain on leaves by gently dabbing with a soft cloth if necessary to prevent fungal development overnight.
Verify air circulation around the pot is unobstructed and consistent. Adjust any nearby items if airflow is restricted.
Reflect on today's light exposure and temperature consistency, noting any significant changes for future adjustments.
